attributes.board_name: Nebraska Board of Pharmacy (DHHS Licensure Unit)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE; Nebraska Council on Continuing Pharmaceutical Education; ACCME-approved Category 1 CE; other providers meeting the ACPE Criteria for Quality
rules.audit_note: Random audit by mail; keep CE documentation at least 4 years; do not send certificates unless requested.
rules.notes: Licenses must be renewed by January 1 of even-numbered years; 30 hours earned in the 24 months before renewal. Inactive status available at any time.
